title: Paired-Acquisition Neural Factorization: An End-to-End Computational Pathology Pipeline
description: Program-level PA-NF preprint spanning paired-scanner representation learning, whole-slide neural aggregation, spatial-modeling extensions, and multi-institutional learning. The work includes SCORPION and independent multi-scanner canine SCC representation studies, a 10,611-slide PANDA Phikon pipeline with TransnnMIL and dominance-aware federated stress experiments, CAMELYON17/WILDS held-out-center weighting studies, and the PCam patch benchmark. The strongest results are comparator-specific and are not presented as clinical validation or a universal state-of-the-art claim.
